title: Inventory Ghost
description: Lets you toggle hiding your player skin in the inventory preview, useful for privacy while clipping or using alts
body:
Lets you toggle the visibility of your player skin in the inventory preview.

This is useful for players who want extra privacy while recording clips, playing on alternate accounts, or avoiding their skin being shown in screenshots/videos. When enabled, the mod replaces the normal inventory player preview with a hidden/blanked-out version

You can switch the toggle keybind, located in your Minecraft Keybinds "Inventory Ghost" category. 
![Showcase Of Keybind](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/f98275119eed4b946d60137ea2fd69899af20c94.png)
